reply: Thank you, Leonie—it’s been a pleasure hearing a little of your story. Wishing you and Marc a happy anniversary and more happy wandering in Nice.

threads.detail: Returning for the tenth anniversary of meeting; will revisit the port, where they met over a folded paper map. Nothing else planned yet.
A private note about still happily getting lost together is welcome; no public fuss or rose-petal production. A wish, not an arrangement.
Enjoy slow wandering with long coffee stops.
Stops to sketch old building facades.
Enjoys secondhand record shops, old soul especially Bill Withers, and records with history.
Share a double bed but use one duvet each; Marc gets cold and Leonie sleeps warm. Easy about pillows.

retainedFacts.label: Meeting memory and return plans
retainedFacts.value: They met near the port over a hopelessly folded paper map and plan to wander back there; nothing else is planned yet.
retainedFacts.sourceQuote: We met near the port over a hopelessly folded paper map, so we'll wander back there. Nothing else planned yet.

retainedFacts.label: Private anniversary note and boundaries
retainedFacts.value: A little private note about still happily getting lost together would be welcome; no public fuss or rose-petal production.
retainedFacts.sourceQuote: A little private note would be lovely, something about still happily getting lost together. Just no public fuss or rose-petal production, please.

retainedFacts.sourceQuote: I stop to sketch old building facades, and Marc can disappear into a secondhand record shop for hours.

retainedFacts.sourceQuote: Old soul, especially Bill Withers; he loves finding a record with a bit of history.
